candidate.why: the executable's provenance is this manifest, not the commit the runner happens to sit on: the lane that measures is not the lane that builds, and git rev-parse in the measuring tree describes neither the exe nor the tree it came from

episodic_axis.reason: No instrument in this repository measures an episodic recall axis. The gold set's classes are answer-cardinality labels (one note answers vs several); they are reported here under their own names and are NOT renamed to 'episodic'/'concept'. This axis is open, not covered.

identity_stability.why: an input that moved between the first query and the last one splits the run across two measurements, and nothing in the numbers would say so

index.note: there is no CLI flag that moves the product's state root; it is derived from the vault path (VaultPaths.Hash). --state-root exists for fixtures that drive a backend shim, and any override is recorded here.

index_witness.expected: with no index present the witness note must come back
index_witness.instrument: query the witness term with no index present; a full scan must reach the note
